Configure R8/ProGuard by editing the rules file. This step is necessary because without proper configuration ProGuard may break your project.

With this you can configure specific local libraries to be included in the R8/ProGuard process. (Note: enabling this will ignore the DEX files of the local libraries you selected and force Sketchware to compile them into dex, which will noticeably slow down compilation.)
Enabling R8/ProGuard will minimize and obfuscate your project, renaming existing classes and methods during compilation.
Using R8/ProGuard can be somewhat risky. Be sure to provide a correct rules configuration file to avoid breaking your project.
